```bash
`r config$remote$prompt` module load 2025
`r config$remote$prompt` module avail Python
```

```output
Python/3.13.5-GCCcore-14.3.0
```

`module load 2025` loads EESSI 2025.06, so `module avail` shows that stack. The Python line is the same build the Snellius tab names. `module spider` searches names that `module avail` hides until another module is loaded.
